contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (913.33) on the p2 Summary Page, which is also Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' ($913.33) and its printed 'Total Contributions Received' ($913.33)
contributions.detail: 1 Schedule A row: 913.33 = the schedule's printed page subtotal = the schedule's printed total = the cover's promoted PER-PERIOD Column A cell. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' also prints 913.33 (this is the filer's only report of the cycle, a '30 Days after withdraw or elimination' report, so period and YTD coincide) and is NOT summed as an increment. The p2 balance ladder closes on its own terms: line 3 (slashed zero = 0) + line 4 913.33 = line 5 913.33; 913.33 - line 6 913.33 = line 7 (slashed zero = 0).

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE (913.33) on the p2 Summary Page, equal to Schedule B's printed 'Subtotal for this page' ($913.33) and its printed 'Total Expenditures Received' ($913.33)
expenditures.detail: 6 Schedule B rows sum to 484.51 + 14.42 + 110.04 + 34.57 + 249.79 + 20.00 = 913.33 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed schedule total = the cover's promoted per-period Column A cell = line 6 of the balance ladder. Column B YTD 913.33 is the same figure (single-report cycle) and is retained as cumulative, never summed as an increment. The arithmetic also SETTLES two cells the handwriting leaves ambiguous: 110.04 (row 3) and 14.42 (row 2) are each forced to the cent by the other five rows against the printed subtotal, and a 900 dpi cell crop of row 3 independently rendered '110.04' — closure and glyph agree.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only closed on both sides; the monetary-plus-in-kind convention was also tested and is identical here because no row on either schedule is marked in-kind and the form prints no in-kind column or line. NOTE the filer's own wording 'Room Donation' on Schedule B row 6 — it is entered as a 20.00 EXPENDITURE in the money column, not as an in-kind contribution, and is transcribed where the filer put it.
itemized.escalation_note: Four tight cell crops, all LEGIBILITY-only (arithmetic was already closed, and per GOTCHAS closure outranks glyph reading): (1) p4 row-3 amount at 900 dpi rendered '110.04', agreeing with the figure the subtotal forces; (2) p4 row-5 name band at 700/900 dpi resolved the vendor to 'INTERACTIVE TELESIS' with a Carlsbad, CA line and a parenthetical second line the filer squeezed under it; (3) p4 row-6 name band at 900 and 1500 dpi resolved 'ROOM DONATION - LINDA Houskeper' — the surname is written in a compressed hand and the final syllable stays doubtful, so that row is confidence 'low' on the NAME (its amount, 20.00, rendered cleanly and is forced by the subtotal); (4) p4 row-3 name band at 1200 dpi showed the filer's first word SCRIBBLED OUT with 'Flyers - Kinkos' left standing.

itemized.notes: legacy_colAB variant on the '2010 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES' blank; 4 PDF pages: p1 cover ('30 Days after withdraw or elimination', signed 5/20/2010, amendment box marked No, stamped received MAY 21), p2 SUMMARY PAGE, p3 Schedule A, p4 Schedule B. The three numbered sheets carry the filer's own 'Page 1 of 3 / 2 of 3 / 3 of 3' foliation, which EXCLUDES the unnumbered cover — a document property worth knowing when a page ordinal is used to locate the summary page. Both sides close EXACTLY on the promoted per-period Column A figures (913.33 each), i.e. the filer raised and spent the same amount and closed at zero. PAGE-FACE candidate name is 'STEVE HEMINGWAY' (Republican, residence city Orem) — index.csv names NO candidate for this row, and the county's own FILENAME spells it 'Hemmingway' with a double m, which the page face does not support; Schedule A's donor line spells the same person 'STEPHEN HEMINGWAY'. Page-face Office Seeking reads 'UTAH COUNTY ASSESSOR', agreeing with index.csv's 'County Assessor'. Lines 3 and 7 of the balance ladder are SLASHED ZEROS, read 0 under the repo zero-glyph ruling. Not a *_Redacted.pdf — the county published this filing in the clear, so donor/vendor street addresses were visible on the page and were reduced to city/state (contributions) or dropped entirely (expenditures) at READ TIME.
